option_relations.rationale: The option Stiff skin syndrome matches the leaf labels for B3.1 and B4.1, which are also labeled as Stiff skin syndrome.
The option Segmental stiff skin syndrome (SSS) matches the leaf label for B4.2, which is also labeled as Segmental Stiff Skin Syndrome (SSS).
The option Linear Scleroderma (Morphea) is related to the leaf labels for B1.1 and B2.1, which are labeled as Linear Scleroderma and Linear Morphea, respectively.

The option Congenital Fascial Dystrophy (Stiff Skin Syndrome) is related to the leaf labels for B3.4 and B4.3, which are labeled as Other Congenital and Developmental Disorders and Congenital Fascial Dystrophy (Stiff Skin Syndrome), respectively.
